aboutText: A little quiet company, with no account, tracking, or access to other apps. Your companion and its preferences stay on this Mac.
automaticMomentsHelp: Allow occasional greetings, pauses, and naps. Pointer attention and direct interactions remain available when this is off.
automaticMomentsOffDetail: Pointer attention, petting, and play remain available. Pause keeps your companion completely still.
